notes.text:
Source-based partial theorem. Let k be algebraically closed, trivially valued, characteristic zero, X reduced irreducible projective, omega ample and V=(omega^n)>0. The configurations in BJ are closed integrally in their prescribed generic fiber, rather than absolutely normalized. Vertical components E retain b_E=ord_E(t) and v_E=b_E^-1 ord_E. The actual mixed raw model measure is sum_E b_E product_i((omega_i,model+D_i)|E) delta_vE, including cycle multiplicities. Nefness makes its weights nonnegative; central/generic rational equivalence gives mass (omega_1...omega_n). The compactified symmetric pairing extends by decreasing model majorants and is finite on mixed E1 tuples. Pairing with (0,h) defines integration against actual algebraic PL tests; positivity, uniform density and Radon representation give the genuine measure.

Energy is E(phi)=pairing((omega,phi)^(n+1))/((n+1)V), E(0)=0 and E(phi+c)=E(phi)+c. Probability MA is raw MA/V. BJ7.19 gives actual model agreement and exact mass; weighted7.21 uses the pairing containing the test minus the zero-test pairing. Its printed sign reversal is corrected. Strict-max locality assigns the winning potential its own measure, and weighted limits must be taken separately for max(phi_j,psi_j) and psi_j. Equal masses give integral_{phi<psi} MA(psi)<=integral_{phi<psi} MA(phi). Mixed intersection negativity, finite-energy divisorial tests and BJ4.22 give one-constant uniqueness; domination10.6 also holds before EP.

A raw target nu must have mass V. With mu=nu/V the exact condition is sup_{psi in E1}(E(psi)-integral psi dmu)<infinity. BJ9.20 equates it with integrability of every E1 potential in the irreducible scope. Bounded-J integration and I(t psi,0)<=n t^2 I(psi,0) give the scaling estimate; actual MA targets satisfy the condition by the tangent energy inequality. Support is unrestricted. Under EP, general5.11 compactness, two-sided8.5 energy differentiation,9.19 integration continuity and energy usc give genuine variational attainment. BJ12.8 makes onto MA equivalent to EP and completeness. Neither the operator nor strict concavity proves singular EP. The raw variational functional VE-integral phi dnu is translation invariant precisely at mass V. Dimension zero is immediate.

notes.text:
Independent proof draft using n1. The corrected local class selects finitely many rational affine log-norm branches, each finite on its neighborhood. Infinite or identically-zero coordinates used with coefficient zero are discarded before logs. Contact means b(t prime)>=ell(t prime)+C and b(t)=ell(t)+C, retaining the same constant. Published Ducros3.2 and valued-image1.2 give finite rational polyhedral images on compact strict Laurent domains, with dimension at most analytic dimension. Equality-hyperplane refinement fixes a continuous finite selection on each connected relative cell; continuity extends to its closure. Clearing rational data makes closure preimages strict Laurent domains and their finite cover admissible. This supplies actual strict-G Q-PL membership, rather than declaring a relative picture a model.

Every smooth analytic curve map over the completed algebraic closure pulls coordinates back to analytic units. Local algebraicity concerns the source curve, not the map. Unit logs factor through one semistable skeleton and balance harmonically. Finite selections are lisse after finitely many edge intersections, allowing real breakpoints. Subtracting the harmonic contact support makes every outgoing slope nonnegative; the weighted harmonic sum is zero. Type-I/IV germs are constant, boundary slopes are not tested, and proper compactification is supplied before Wanner Section4.

For an actually glued continuous ample rational metric, norm-one frames and their actual transition cocycle give GM2.10 formal representation. GR5.1/5.4, GJR7.1/7.6, GM3.11 and represented-model Lemma3.3 detect nefness. Proper projective algebraic representation keeps the prescribed generic fiber. BE1805.01016v3 Theorem7.8 then supplies uniform FS approximation in general-variety scope. General R-PL current positivity or pullback is not assumed; GR Remark1.8 and CLD strict-integer hypotheses are retained.

Exact Gauss descent uses only K=k((varpi)), never a Laurent expansion over its completed algebraic closure. H0 base change writes generating sections as Laurent sums of k-sections. Canonical proper-center norms of these sections are at most one. The Gauss metric has a compact lower bound, so sufficiently high coefficient terms can be removed exactly and uniformly. Retained sections generate, or a closed base-locus k-point would give minus infinity. BE5.14/5.16(vi) express a model function as a pure FS difference on an auxiliary common generic class M. Adding a cancelling FS metric on aH_K-M by5.17 puts both final systems on the descending aH_K; exact coefficient descent then makes the Gauss value actual BJ algebraic PL. The difference is not asserted positive. GM2.7 gives compact local extensions only after strict representation.

On nonnormal X, section localization writes f_i=tau_i/s^d_i and a=s product tau_i cuts out exactly the required principal open. Clear constraint numerators by one power a^m, add complete very ample generators, and use a rational negative floor. This gives compact Q={v<=0} and P={v<=-epsilon} inside int Q. BJ PL density and clipping give actual finite nonnegative subordinate PL partitions summing exactly one.

For a bounded tuple and tests, choose one tail collar h=Av+M+1 and theta=omega+ddc p. Nested compact closed-set emptiness gives a whole winning boundary strip. Psi_i=max(u_i-h,0), zero outside, is genuinely global by the metric bridge. Phi_i=Psi_i/A+p and G=v-p+(M+1)/A satisfy u_i/A=Phi_i+G and ddc u_i=A(omega+ddc Phi_i) on P. Local mixed mass carries A^n only in this divided convention. A third shared collar proves approximation/overlap independence. BJ7.21 handles bounded weights; signed PL cutoffs are passed as two positive terms. Exact compact extensions and global pairing symmetry prove IBP, and a finite PL partition telescopes the mass to ddc1=0, yielding raw V. Locality, comparison and independent divisorial order follow. BJ2.12/2.33 ample model atoms give domination without a Dirac equation. Known smooth EP then gives smooth local/global equality via continuous-majorant nets; actual nef pullback references follow by adding ample classes and class closure.

New independent proof draft using n1 and n2, in their corrected rational auxiliary scope. Let Y be smooth irreducible affine over arbitrary retained k, u finite at the generic trivial seminorm, with a proper birational witness making its pullback locally a decreasing corrected contact limit, and u<=b+C for an actual AFS exhaustion. A projective closure and boundary-only characteristic-zero resolution give a smooth compactification with effective ample boundary D. For each blowup I O=O(-E), E effective and -E relatively ample. Large m makes m pi*D-E both ample and effective with exactly the preimage boundary support. Choose B=O(rD), boundary section s and rational reference h=h0+p, g=-log||s||h>=1. Finite pole clearing F/s^d gives a uniform bound u<=Ag. Projectively dominate, compactify and resolve the witness to Z->X; arbitrary witness quasiprojectivity is not assumed.

For c>1, floors Psi_M=max(pi*u-cA pi*g,M), constant M at the boundary, have a whole constant collar from the upper bound. They lie in the actual nef reference cA pi*h; n2 smooth nef local/global equality makes them genuine. Decreasing floors give a nontrivial genuine limit. Its canonical potential includes cA pi*p. Actual BJ Lemma5.13 is applied only to the smooth target class cAB, whose larger ample classes have smooth EP. Descent identifies Q=u-cAg+cAp=u-cAg0 on Y. BJ12.16/12.18(iii) now applies to this already genuine ample-class potential, with no countable-field hypothesis. Example3.9 binds Hdom to the fixed rational line bundle. Complete high very ample section systems, a low boundary-section constant branch and generator ratios convert the decreasing sequence exactly to actual AFS functions tending to u.

Controlled approximation starts with an already supplied sequence u_j decreasing to u<=g. Negative floors C_r and increasing R_r>2-C_r give compact Q_r. Closed-set emptiness picks increasing j_r with u_jr<g+1 there. The global potentials max(u_jr-2g,C_r) on Q_r, constant outside, have winning boundary collars and are genuine. On expanding annuli the new branch is below 1-g<=1-R_(r-1)<C_(r-1), proving decrease. Uniform FS errors epsilon_r=4^-r and shifts 2 sum_(i>=r)epsilon_i yield actual decreasing AFS approximants bounded by 2g+constant.

On Y_f use g_c=max(g,-c/3 log|f|) including f^-1 among generators. The controlled sequence satisfies w_i+c log|f|<=max(2g+c log|f|,c/3 log|f|)+B. Floors therefore give continuous contact functions constant on true neighborhoods of Z(f), with one common upper exhaustion h. Single-function moving collars make b_i-2h genuine, and max(b_i-2h,-i) continuous at the projective boundary. Uniform FS approximation and summable shifts give the damped v_c. For c_j decreasing to zero these functions need not decrease. In one smooth ample class use H_m=(sup_(j>=m)(v_cj-2Ag0))^*. Smooth EP supplies membership. On Y_f the exact tail term is sup_(j>=m)c_j log|f|=c_m max(log|f|,0); it is usc there. The decreasing limit is v-2Ag0 and gives a regularizable extension. Bounded floors and divisorial order on a resolved witness identify it with an existing weak input on the removed set. Usc or density alone is insufficient.

For finite locally free B/A of rank d, det(mult_(sum T_i b_i)) factors geometrically with actual Artinian lengths.
